**5.2.14** **Z/IP** **6LoWPAN** **Command** **Class,** **version** **1**


The Z/IP 6LoWPAN Command Class supports the transmission of IPv6 Packets over Z-Wave networks.

The Z/IP 6LoWPAN Command Class, version 1 is defined by RFC 7428.
